name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: A 5th-century rock fortress built by King Kashyapa, rising 200 m above the surrounding plains.

name: Ruwanweli Maha Seya
description: A magnificent stupa built by King Dutugemunu, considered a architectural marvel in ancient Sri Lanka.

name: Sri Dalada Maligawa
description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic located in the royal palace complex of the former Kingdom of Kandy.

name: Ella
description: A hill-country village known for hiking trails, tea estates and the famous Nine Arches Bridge.

name: Mirissa
description: A picturesque coastal town renowned for whale watching, golden sand beaches and surfing.

name: Arugam Bay
description: A popular surf destination on the southeast coast of Sri Lanka with world-class wave breaks.

name: Yala National Park
description: Sri Lanka's most visited national park, famous for having one of the highest leopard densities in the world.

name: Minneriya National Park
description: Famous for 'The Gathering', an incredible wildlife spectacle where hundreds of Asian elephants congregate.

name: Nuwara Eliya Tea Gardens
description: Scenic misty hills covered with lush green tea plantations, often referred to as 'Little England'.

name: Galle Fort
description: A historical fortress built by the Portuguese in the 16th century and later extensively fortified by the Dutch.
